name: Cómpeta (Spain)
description: Horizontally divided blue over white, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Cómpeta (a castle on blue above grapes on white).
history: Municipal flag of Cómpeta; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Cómpeta arms — castle on blue above grapes on white
